from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import xarray as xr


class TestAlignOuterMaxCallDepthHardQA:
    def test_align_outer_max_call_depth_case(self) -> None:
        a = xr.DataArray(
            np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]], dtype=np.float64),
            dims=("time", "x"),
            coords={"time": [0, 1], "x": [10, 20]},
            name="a",
        )
        b = xr.DataArray(
            np.array([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]], dtype=np.float64),
            dims=("time", "x"),
            coords={"time": [1, 2], "x": [20, 30]},
            name="b",
        )
        c = xr.DataArray(
            np.array([[9.0, 10.0], [11.0, 12.0]], dtype=np.float64),
            dims=("time", "x"),
            coords={"time": [2, 3], "x": [30, 40]},
            name="c",
        )

        a2, b2, c2 = xr.align(a, b, c, join="outer", copy=False, fill_value=-999.0)

        assert a2.sizes["time"] == 4 and a2.sizes["x"] == 4
        assert b2.sizes["time"] == 4 and b2.sizes["x"] == 4
        assert c2.sizes["time"] == 4 and c2.sizes["x"] == 4

import sys
import numpy as np
import xarray as xr

print('xarray file', xr.__file__)

TARGET_PARTS = ('/xarray/core/', '/xarray/structure/')
stack=[]
max_depth=0
max_event=None


def in_target(filename):
    f=filename.replace('\\','/')
    return any(p in f for p in TARGET_PARTS)


def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global max_depth, max_event
    fn=frame.f_code.co_filename.replace('\\','/')
    if in_target(fn) and event in ('call','return','exception'):
        if event=='call':
            stack.append(frame)
            d=len(stack)
            if d>max_depth:
                max_depth=d
                max_event=(event, frame.f_code.co_name, fn, frame.f_lineno)
        elif event=='return':
            # remove this frame if present
            for i in range(len(stack)-1, -1, -1):
                if stack[i] is frame:
                    stack.pop(i)
                    break
        elif event=='exception':
            d=len(stack)
            if d>max_depth:
                max_depth=d
                max_event=(event, frame.f_code.co_name, fn, frame.f_lineno)
    return tracer


a = xr.DataArray(
    np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]], dtype=np.float64),
    dims=("time", "x"),
    coords={"time": [0, 1], "x": [10, 20]},
    name="a",
)
b = xr.DataArray(
    np.array([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]], dtype=np.float64),
    dims=("time", "x"),
    coords={"time": [1, 2], "x": [20, 30]},
    name="b",
)
c = xr.DataArray(
    np.array([[9.0, 10.0], [11.0, 12.0]], dtype=np.float64),
    dims=("time", "x"),
    coords={"time": [2, 3], "x": [30, 40]},
    name="c",
)

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    xr.align(a, b, c, join='outer', copy=False, fill_value=-999.0)
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

print('max_depth', max_depth)
print('max_event', max_event)
print('stack_remaining', len(stack))

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import xarray as xr


class TestCombineByCoordsMaxCallDepthHardQA:
    def test_combine_by_coords_max_call_depth_case(self) -> None:
        time_a = np.array([0, 1], dtype=np.int64)
        time_b = np.array([2, 3], dtype=np.int64)
        x_a = np.array([10, 20], dtype=np.int64)
        x_b = np.array([30, 40], dtype=np.int64)

        ds_00 = xr.Dataset(
            {"temp": (("time", "x"), np.array([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]], dtype=np.float64))},
            coords={"time": time_a, "x": x_a},
        )
        ds_01 = xr.Dataset(
            {"temp": (("time", "x"), np.array([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]], dtype=np.float64))},
            coords={"time": time_a, "x": x_b},
        )
        ds_10 = xr.Dataset(
            {"temp": (("time", "x"), np.array([[9.0, 10.0], [11.0, 12.0]], dtype=np.float64))},
            coords={"time": time_b, "x": x_a},
        )
        ds_11 = xr.Dataset(
            {"temp": (("time", "x"), np.array([[13.0, 14.0], [15.0, 16.0]], dtype=np.float64))},
            coords={"time": time_b, "x": x_b},
        )

        combined = xr.combine_by_coords(
            [ds_10, ds_01, ds_11, ds_00],
            fill_value=-999.0,
            combine_attrs="no_conflicts",
        )

        assert isinstance(combined, xr.Dataset)
        assert combined.sizes["time"] == 4
        assert combined.sizes["x"] == 4
        assert "temp" in combined.data_vars

import sys

import xarray as xr

TARGET_PARTS = ('/xarray/core/', '/xarray/structure/')

trace_depth=0
max_trace_depth=0
max_trace_event=None

max_abs_depth=0
max_abs_event=None


def in_target(filename):
    f=filename.replace('\\','/')
    return any(p in f for p in TARGET_PARTS)


def abs_depth(frame):
    d=0
    while frame is not None:
        d += 1
        frame = frame.f_back
    return d


def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global trace_depth, max_trace_depth, max_trace_event, max_abs_depth, max_abs_event
    fn = frame.f_code.co_filename.replace('\\','/')
    if in_target(fn) and event in ('call','return','exception'):
        ad = abs_depth(frame)
        if ad > max_abs_depth:
            max_abs_depth = ad
            max_abs_event = (event, frame.f_code.co_name, fn, frame.f_lineno)
        if event == 'call':
            trace_depth += 1
            if trace_depth > max_trace_depth:
                max_trace_depth = trace_depth
                max_trace_event = (event, frame.f_code.co_name, fn, frame.f_lineno)
        elif event == 'return':
            trace_depth -= 1
        elif event == 'exception':
            if trace_depth > max_trace_depth:
                max_trace_depth = trace_depth
                max_trace_event = (event, frame.f_code.co_name, fn, frame.f_lineno)
    return tracer


a = xr.DataArray(np.array([[1.,2.],[3.,4.]]), dims=('time','x'), coords={'time':[0,1],'x':[10,20]}, name='a')
b = xr.DataArray(np.array([[5.,6.],[7.,8.]]), dims=('time','x'), coords={'time':[1,2],'x':[20,30]}, name='b')
c = xr.DataArray(np.array([[9.,10.],[11.,12.]]), dims=('time','x'), coords={'time':[2,3],'x':[30,40]}, name='c')

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    xr.align(a,b,c,join='outer',copy=False,fill_value=-999.0)
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

print('max_trace_depth', max_trace_depth)
print('max_trace_event', max_trace_event)
print('final_trace_depth', trace_depth)
print('max_abs_depth', max_abs_depth)
print('max_abs_event', max_abs_event)
